title: Separate two heat terms
statement:
A 50.0 g liquid warms by 4.00 K in a cup with heat capacity 35.0 J/K. The liquid’s specific heat is 4.00 J/(g·K). What heat did the cup and liquid absorb together?

[_]{a}

explanations: Both warmed and both contributions are positive.

hints: One heat capacity is total and one is specific.
